title: Let a brief declare lead edits to worker-forbidden paths
body: Outcome: krn brief check accepts a lead-edit path that spec/worker-scope.json forbids when the brief lists it under a "Lead edits" section (or slice run --worker none passes a flag that skips the forbidden check), so a --worker none slice can declare its whole diff (t-b1pxnvk: the checklist edit had to be dropped from Allowed paths and named only in Settled decisions). Forbidden paths under Allowed paths stay refused. Proof: a brief rules test: forbidden path under Allowed paths exits 65; the same path under Lead edits passes and is excluded from the printed --allow argv.
